kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Moulded M8 and M12 cable assemblies with documented connector sealing.
intro.zh: 具有原厂接口密封依据的 M8、M12 模制电缆组件。

intro.en: Sealed circular connector components for outdoor interface selection.
intro.zh: 用于户外接口选型的密封圆形连接材料。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Review the connector, cable exit, branch joints and free ends together.
copy.zh: 将连接器、线缆出口、分支接点与自由端一起核对。

copy.en: Confirm mating parts, seal geometry and the specified locking method.
copy.zh: 确认对插件、密封几何及规定的锁紧方式。

copy.en: Select the jacket for actual sunlight, temperature, moisture and abrasion exposure.
copy.zh: 按实际日晒、温度、潮湿与磨损工况选择护套。

copy.en: Define protection at splices, enclosure entries and any exposed conductor ends.
copy.zh: 明确汇接处、机壳入口及裸露线端的防护结构。

copy.en: Set bend clearance, clamp locations and strain relief around sealed interfaces.
copy.zh: 围绕密封接口确定弯折空间、固定位置与应力释放。

copy.en: Confirm the required water-exposure test for the finished harness. Connector ratings alone do not define whole-harness protection.
copy.zh: 针对成品线束确认所需涉水测试；接头等级不能单独定义整束防护能力。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道
